definitions.explanation: A person responsible for keeping records, taking minutes, or handling correspondence in an organization, committee, or political body.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{書記|しょき}を{務|つと}める。
examples.english: To serve as the recording secretary for the meeting.

examples.japanese: {書記|しょき}が{議事録|ぎじろく}を{作成|さくせい}した。
{生徒会|せいとかい}の{書記|しょき}に{立候補|りっこうほ}して、{選挙|せんきょ}で{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: I ran for secretary of the student council and was elected.

notes:
USAGE:
{書記|しょき} is used in various organizational contexts:
- School: {生徒会|せいとかい}{書記|しょき} (student council secretary)
- Political: {書記長|しょきちょう} (secretary-general, as in a political party)
- Organizational: {会議|かいぎ}の{書記|しょき} (meeting secretary/minute-taker)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書記|しょき}を{務|つと}める: to serve as secretary
- {書記長|しょきちょう}: secretary-general
- {書記|しょき}{官|かん}: clerk (government/court)
- {議事録|ぎじろく}の{書記|しょき}: minutes secretary

NOTE:
In political contexts, {書記長|しょきちょう} (secretary-general) is a high-ranking position, notably used for the leader of communist parties ({共産党|きょうさんとう}{書記長|しょきちょう}).
